cultural_region: Middle East / North Africa / Eastern Mediterranean
description: العاب تعليم اللغة - The Arabic locale centers on the Suez Canal as the historical and pedagogical focal point. Trade here is not just commerce — it is the meeting of civilizations (Africa, Asia, Europe). Pedagogy emphasizes the 'witness' as a community elder whose testimony binds contracts and resolves disputes.
pedagogical_lens: The shahada-witness: testimony as the binding force. The MENA framing teaches that every transaction requires witnesses, every port requires trust networks, and the substrate's witness-log IS the cultural practice of testified commerce.
